description: This file defines the AveragingCachePressureMonitor class, which implements cache pressure monitoring based on averaging pressure contributions over time. It includes methods for recording pressure contributions, checking pressure status, and logging pressure-related events.

classes.name: AveragingCachePressureMonitor
classes.description: A cache pressure monitor that uses an averaging algorithm to determine if the cache is under pressure, based on pressure contributions and thresholds.

methods.name: AveragingCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the monitor with a default or specified flow control threshold, logger, and optional cache monitor.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution, applying a weight based on whether the contribution is below or above the flow control threshold.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks if the cache is under pressure at the given current time, recalculating pressure if necessary.

methods.name: CalculatePressure
methods.description: Calculates the current pressure based on accumulated contributions and updates the pressure status, logging changes.
